name: slonik
description_en: A Node.js PostgreSQL client with runtime and build time type safety, and composable SQL.
readme_excerpt: Slonik A battle-tested Node.js PostgreSQL client with strict types, detailed logging and assertions. Principles - Promotes writing raw SQL. - Discourages ad-hoc dynamic generation of SQL.
